subject: Making awkward kitchen spaces useful
hook: Bespoke kitchens for rooms that don't fit standard units.
gbp:
Bespoke kitchens designed around awkward rooms.

If your kitchen has a deep corner, a chimney breast, a boiler in the way or a gap that standard units never quite fill, a made-to-measure kitchen can make every part of the room useful.

Who it's for: homeowners in older or extended houses where walls aren't straight and layouts don't follow catalogue sizes, and anyone tired of filler panels hiding wasted space.

What's included:
- A free, no-obligation design consultation to talk through how you cook and store
- A measuring visit that records bows, recesses, pipes and services
- An itemised quote with transparent pricing and no hidden costs
- Units cut, edged, drilled and assembled in our own workshop and quality-checked before they leave
- Delivery and installation by our own team, with panels scribed to uneven walls

Finishes include matt, super matt, gloss, painted and oak-effect, with soft-close hardware as standard.

We make kitchens for homes across Newcastle-under-Lyme and the wider Stoke-on-Trent area. Tap Book to arrange your design consultation.
